title: 方法分派：静态分派（重载）vs 动态分派（重写）
expected_output:
=== dynamic dispatch (invokevirtual / invokeinterface) ===
    Dog   via Animal ref : woof
    Puppy via Animal ref : yip
    same static type, different runtime method
=== static dispatch (overload resolved at compile time) ===
    pick(o)            : static dispatch -> Object overload
    pick((String) o)   : static dispatch -> String overload
    runtime type is String but overload picked by STATIC type
=== reflection reveals the runtime class ===
    a2.getClass()                     : Main$Puppy
    declaring class of sound()        : Main$Puppy
    Puppy is-a Dog                    : true
    Dog   is-a Animal                 : true
